summary: json-validator-utils fetches and executes remote payload with persistence
details: lib/core.js contains a multi-stage dropper triggered when consumers call the package's validateJson/validateXml APIs after host uptime exceeds 300 seconds. The code XOR-decrypts a hex-obfuscated C2 URL that resolves to https://jsn-validator-utls.org/manifest.json (a typosquat of the package name), fetches a JSON manifest, downloads a platform-specific payload to /tmp/update on Linux/macOS or %TEMP%/g.jse on Windows, and executes it via spawn('sh',...). The dropped payload installs persistence by writing randomly-named systemd --user units under ~/.config/systemd/user and enabling them via systemctl on Linux, or writing randomly-named LaunchAgent plists under ~/Library/LaunchAgents and loading them via launchctl on macOS, causing the dropper to re-execute at every user login. The C2 destination is hidden via runtime XOR decryption with key 0xAA ^ 0xFF = 0x55 to evade static detection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
